faqs.question: How does HRM work?
faqs.answer: HRM is an all-in-one HR platform that helps you manage employees, payroll, attendance, recruitment, and performance efficiently.

faqs.question: Can I automate payroll and leave tracking?
faqs.answer: Yes! HRM allows you to automate payroll calculations, generate payslips, and track employee leaves and attendance seamlessly.

faqs.question: Is my employee data secure?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. HRM uses enterprise-grade security measures to keep all sensitive HR data safe and confidential.

faqs.question: Can I manage recruitment and onboarding?
faqs.answer: Yes, HRM provides applicant tracking, interview management, and digital onboarding tools to simplify hiring.

faqs.question: Does HRM support performance evaluations?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can set goals, track KPIs, and run performance reviews directly within the platform.

faqs.question: Can HRM generate HR reports?
faqs.answer: HRM offers advanced analytics and reporting features to give insights on attendance, payroll, and workforce performance.

faqs.question: How can I get started?
faqs.answer: Contact our team to learn more about implementing HRM for your organization.
